items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Wow. I wonder if it’s on film, what do you think, Tim?

ctx.x: In between the Charlie Parker Festival and the Fletcher Henderson Festival, I went to Hamilton, New York and played in a football game as a member of the Aaron Burr Lucky Shot Marching and Kazoo Orchestra.
Wow. I wonder if it’s on film, what do you think, Tim? Boy wouldn’t that be something if we had a film of that.
Yeah. I doubt you’d have a film of the halftime show. That’d be great.
